bio: In this village on the outskirts of Grenoble, this charming little restaurant sports white walls and exposed stone, warm-toned hardwood floors and elegant light wood tables. Chef Joan Bois cooks up simple and unpretentious cuisine that follows the seasons, readily incorporating the odd exotic touch inspired by his extensive travels (his passion). Think cod with a green curry and coconut milk sauce, accompanied by herby bamboo rice. Aurélie Josserand takes care of matters on the restaurant floor, providing a warm welcome and attentive service....
